resources.string: The adapter is not set up yet. We will guide you step by step.
The ECU files (.prg/.grp) are missing. We will guide you step by step.
Three steps to get the app ready. Each step refreshes by itself when you come back from settings.
Bluetooth: you still need to choose the ELM327 device in settings.
There are no .prg/.grp files in the folder.
Minimum for the E39 and E46 menus:
Copy the files from your own INPA/EDIABAS installation into that folder. The app does not include them or offer downloads.
Reads the battery and ignition without changing anything in the car. Plug the cable into the car and switch the ignition on.
The adapter is the problem: it is not ready. Check step 1.
The files are the problem: neither UTILITY.prg nor UTILITY.grp is in the ECU folder. Check step 2.

The car or the cable is the problem: the adapter is ready and the files are there, but nothing answers. Check that the cable is in the OBD socket, that the ignition is on and that the cable is the right one for your car.
There is communication (battery %1$s V), but the ignition is off. Switch it on and test again.
